juneyaooo/rea-video.caption:
You can now see exactly how any viral video was made, shot by shot, for free.

rea-video is a free, open-source tool that runs inside Claude Code. Drop in a video and it:
1. Labels every shot: real camera, AI or code animation
2. Maps every caption, cut, music beat and sound effect
3. Writes the pro
